  `payload` STRING,
  `event_time` TIMESTAMP(3)
) WITH (
  'connector' = 'kafka',

  'properties.bootstrap.servers' = 'kafka:9092',

) WITH (

  'format' = 'json',
  'sink.delivery-guarantee' = 'at-least-once'
);

```yaml
apiVersion: kafka.strimzi.io/v1beta2
kind: KafkaTopic
metadata:
  name: sensor-readings
  labels:
    strimzi.io/cluster: my-cluster
spec:
  partitions: 3
  replicas: 3
  config:
      retention.ms: 2592000000
---
apiVersion: kafka.strimzi.io/v1beta2
kind: KafkaTopic
metadata:
  name: sensor-readings-clean
  labels:
    strimzi.io/cluster: my-cluster
spec:
  partitions: 3
  replicas: 3
  config:
      retention.ms: 2592000000
```

```yaml
apiVersion: flink.apache.org/v1beta1
kind: FlinkDeployment
metadata:
  name: sensor-readings-clean
spec:
  image: flink-sql-runner:1.20  # flink:1.20 with sql-runner.jar and the SQL script in /opt/flink/usrlib
  flinkVersion: v1_20
  serviceAccount: flink
  flinkConfiguration:
    execution.checkpointing.dir: "s3://flink-state/checkpoints"
    execution.checkpointing.interval: "10 s"
    execution.checkpointing.mode: "AT_LEAST_ONCE"
    taskmanager.numberOfTaskSlots: "4"
    execution.checkpointing.savepoint-dir: "s3://flink-state/savepoints"
  jobManager:
    resource:
      memory: "2048m"
      cpu: 1
  taskManager:
    resource:
      memory: "8Gi"
      cpu: 4
  job:
    jarURI: local:///opt/flink/usrlib/sql-runner.jar
    args: ["/opt/flink/usrlib/sql-scripts/pipeline.sql"]
    parallelism: 1
    upgradeMode: savepoint
```
